newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil ends firm, December meal ends higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil ends firm, December meal ends higher.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures closed firm on short covering and unwinding of meal/oil spreads before the expiration of the December contracts slated for 1201 CST Thursday, traders said.
But gains in soyoil were trimmed on a late local selloff in soybeans, they said.
Soymeal closed mixed but mostly lower with the December gaining on short covering before expiration.
Soyoil closed unchanged to 0.10 cent per lb higher, with December up 0.08 at 23.24. Soymeal was $4.00 per ton higher to $1.20 lower, with December up $4.00 at $245.00.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 27,000 contracts, above the 23,288 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 26,000 contracts, above the 21,801 traded Tuesday.
